messages:
lina_infra: FYI nightly p99 spikes on eu2-ephemeral; pattern: many tiny bursts from 3 tenants. looks like NIC tx queue bursts.
oscar_ops: saw same. node logs show `tx_busy` blips and `irq: eth0` thrash around 00:05.
trina_sre: alloc-bot flagged low egress headroom and did a preemptible fallback for some requests. that avoided full outage but latency still noisy.
alloc-bot: ALERT: pool eu2-ephemeral-7 egress_headroom=6%. Fallback routing active.
lina_infra: proposal: ephemeral carveout (1-2% of pool) for tiny-RPC tenants during high tail events. canary on rack7 with auto-reclaim after 10m.
oscar_ops: +1, add NIC-level qos and irqbalance sticky in canary to isolate IRQ storm.
trina_sre: add a rollback alert if p999 for non-carved tenants increases >8% post-rollout. also measure cost delta.
lina_infra: action: oscar will deploy canary in 45m (INFRA-4909). trina will watch alerts.
oscar_ops: deploying now, will post node output.
